notes.title: v1.0.7 Released! Stability Updates + Streamer Mode Options!
notes.content:
[b]New Update (v1.0.7)[/b] 

[u]This recent update has several changes including[/u]: 
[list]
[*] [b]Major improvements to game stability[/b]
[*] Major improvements to game stability! (We put this twice so you know how much more stable the game is)
[*] Bug fixes out the wazoo
[*]Added setting for windowed mode (Alt + Enter also works)
[*]Added clue submission indicators to the "Boot Player" menu (Now you can tell which players have already submitted their clues in the current round)
[*]Added some fun, new sound effects!
[*]Made it more clear that Robot and Programmer votes are not included in the final vote
[*] [b]New "Streamer friendly" Settings![/b]
[list]
[*] New option to automatically hide the GameCode and copy the hidden GameCode to your clipboard
[*] New option to set custom timer lengths in Settings
[*] The "host" can now start the game without waiting for the VIP to do so (click on the "Ready to Start!" icon once enough players have joined.)
[/list]
[/list]

Lastly, we want to thank everyone for their suggestions and feedback!

notes.title: JULY DEMO UPDATE! - v0.7.6 - Observer mode! Pre-results screen!
notes.content:
Howdy folks! We're pushing one last major update to the DEMO with some new features before our full launch in August!

[list]
[*] Bug fixes! We fixed a number of bugs involving booting players
[*] Pre-Results screen! We've added a screen after final deliberation showing how the votes were cast and how the winner is decided. This will help make it more clear who wins and why
[*] Observer mode! Players that join the game after the maximum number of players (or in the middle of a game) will become "Observers". Their votes will be displayed during the deliberation stage, and can help sway the vote! However, their votes will not be counted towards the final score
[*] The deliberation screen has been updated to no longer show the clue list
[*] Added a setting for maximum number of players. Choose between 5 and 10. Any players that try to join after that will join as Observers
[/list]

notes.title: Technical Difficulties - Please Stand By!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38834683/ac56173955d0bdf2ee7fb9b5bd43c892d97c7ff0.png[/img]

First off, we'd love to thank everyone who has play-tested Assimilate so far and given us feedback. We have been blown away by the support and are so grateful for all the comments, suggestions, etc. You all are honestly the very, very best!

If you have played our game in the last few days, you might have noticed that one of our recent updates seemed to result in some connectivity issues for certain players. Though it does not happen every game, it was happening often enough that we felt the need to temporarily pause the Playtest until we get it resolved. In addition to improving the mobile connectivity issue, we are also looking to include the following highly-requested features/upgrades in our next update:
[list]
[*] AFK Protection (i.e. Allow the Game Host to boot idle players)
[*] Twitch Sign-In (to make it easier for those streaming to 
[*] Optional "Hidden Game Code" mode (where streamers can access 
[/list]
Again, we're sorry for any players who incurred these disconnection issues since our last update, but assure you we will have Assimilate back up and running again soon, with some fun, new features to boot!

Thanks again from your pals at Friendship is Fun Studios! :)

notes.title: NEW UPDATE - QuickPlay mode added, minor bug fixes, & more!
notes.content:
[b]Changes/Updates to TV Screens[/b]
[list]
[*] The biggest addition in this update includes the new game mode, "Quickplay" which allows users to play a single, 1-round game. Ideal for new groups to learn how to play the game or those who want to try out the game in a quick, simple format.
[*] Updated some font sizes and colors to make them more legible.
[*] Fixed some audio issues with the tutorial video
[*] Fixed some bugs with the "Esc" menu when accessed in the game lobby.
[/list]

[b]Changes/Updates to Phone Screens[/b]
[list]
[*] One of the most common requests we got from play testers so far was the functionality for the game to prohibit/prevent users from entering the same clue more than once, so that's been added in.
[*] In addition, we have added an error message if players attempt to enter a clue that matches the Password.
[*] Adjusted the "how to play" instructions on the phone to include more explanation for players during the deliberation rounds.
[*] Fixed some bugs that caused display issues on larger iphones.
[/list]

notes.title: Now accepting Playtesters for Assimilate! (A Party Game)
notes.content:
The Assimilate! (A Party Game) playtest is [b]now live[/b] for playtesting. Only sign up for this play test if you're comfortable playing an early prototype as there is still a lot of tweaks, bugs, and gameplay changes left to make. We have taken the liberty of answering some FAQs below, for your reference.

[u]How do I sign up to play test[/u]?
Go to our store page and click the "Request Access" button to join our playtest waitlist. We will be letting playtesters in waves during the next two weeks and you will be notified by Steam if/when you are eligible to download and play the game. However, please note that we cannot guarantee everyone who signs up will get to play!

[u]How long will this playtest be available[/u]?
We will start this play test session up for two weeks to give everyone time to organize their friends and play through the game, but if things appear to be running smoothly and our bugs/fixes are minimal, we can likely accommodate more playtesters and extend the event further. If early play tests are a little wonky then we [i]might [/i] need to end the open play tests sooner before we can admit more playtesters. So if you're interested in test playing the game, be sure to sign up as soon as possible because we can't guarantee everyone who signs up will get a chance to play.

[u]Does it cost anything to test play?[/u]?
Of course not! Play through the game, for free, and let us know what you think, The most valuable thing we could get from you now is your feedback - so be upfront and honest! :)

[u]How many players does this test play version accommodate[/u]?
As of now the game should function for anywhere between 5 & 10 players, but we're still tweaking the balancing of the game so we may adjust up/down the number of players as necessary.

[u]Is this game nearly finished[/u]?
Not really, no. Please only play if you and your friends are comfortable testing an [i]early[/i] version of the game and are willing to leave us your honest feedback. We are extremely interested in learning what works, what doesn't work, and your suggestions to improve the game as a whole so let us know!

[u]How can I leave you my feedback on the game[/u]?
At the end of every game you will be prompted to leave feedback through a link to a simple Google Survey. None of the questions are required but all are appreciated so please feel free to leave as little, or as much, feedback as you're comfortable giving.

[u]When will the next chance to playtest[/u]?
We do not have an exact date yet for the next chance to playtest, though we are confident there will be other opportunities in the near future to do so. If you are eager and willing to play an early version of the game though, we certainly encourage you to sign up now. Just be sure to fill out the survey at the end of the game and let us know what you think!
